detail.longDescription: Headline: What I believe about the future of software development Me: Apparently this blog post blew up on the bird site. I've been out of the dev game for a long time, having been a pure DBA since 2014. I don't feel particularly qualified to assess the likelihood of these predictions. Still, I have opinions. Including a 'Dave-ism': "Speculation is an exercise in futility". https:// thorstenball.com/blog/2026/09/ 19/what-i-believe-about-the-future-of-software-development/ # Development # Software # OpenSource
